name: Aman Sanger
milestone_by_age_26: Was a Cursor co-founder when the company announced a $60 million Series A on August 22, 2024, at a conservative year-only age of 24. This is company financing, not a personal payout.

Birth-year references identify 2000, consistent with Forbes reporting age 25 in November 2025; ages here use the conservative year-only convention, not an exact birthday. The later $29.3 billion funding valuation describes the company: it does not establish a personal cash payout, an employee grant, or financial independence.
